title: Run a physiotherapy practice's appointments
body: One place where the front desk and four therapists book, see and change appointments, and patients are reminded of them.

title: The front desk books, moves and cancels appointments
body: One person at the front desk handles all changes. Moving an appointment takes a few seconds.

title: Booking form and drag-to-move
body: `booking.js` holds the booking form and moves an appointment when its card is dragged to another time.

title: Patient data stays on servers in the EU
body: No patient data is stored or processed outside the EU, including by services the app calls.

title: Patients are reminded of their appointment in time
body: A patient hears from the practice early enough to rearrange their day or to cancel.

title: Send the reminder as a text message the day before
body: Texts go out at 18:00 on the day before the appointment, through an SMS gateway hosted in Frankfurt. The front desk signs in with the practice's Microsoft accounts.

title: Evening reminder job
body: `reminders.py` runs at 18:00, selects tomorrow's appointments and sends one text per patient through the gateway's HTTP API.

title: Everyone sees who is treated when and by whom
body: Front desk and therapists see the practice's appointments without opening single ones.

title: Show the week as a grid with one column per therapist
body: A week view in the style of a desktop calendar: the days side by side, and within each day one column per therapist.

title: Colour each appointment by treatment type
body: Manual therapy, massage and training each have their own colour, so the mix of a day shows without reading.

title: Rows are 15-minute slots from 7:00 to 20:00
body: Every appointment starts and ends on a slot boundary.

title: Week grid rendering
body: `week-grid.js` draws the grid, places appointments on their slots and colours them by treatment type.
